best_idea: Show a signed split (behind red, ahead green, sign always in the text) for 2 s at full strength, fade it over 2 s, clear it on death, and take the number from the server.
decision_why: Useful for timed zone trials and boss-phase splits; the donor's wall-clock timing would let a pause or hitstop eat the banner, so the sketch ages it on the game clock. The donor's sender is not in the box, so the server computes and sends the signed number under the server tick sub-line, and the client only displays it.
acceptance: In a timed zone trial the player sees a green -0.42 banner at top centre for 2 s, then a 2 s fade; a server test asserts the shown value equals the value the server sent; dying clears the banner; a paused-clock test shows the hold does not run.
